title: Forward approach.
officialText:
Where only a forward approach is provided to the water closet, the clearance shall be 66 inches
(1676 mm) minimum, measured perpendicular from the rear wall, and 48 inches (1219 mm) minimum, measured perpendicular
from the side wall. A lavatory complying with Section P102.6 shall be permitted on the rear wall, 18 inches (457 mm)
minimum from the water closet centerline.
